Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Heavy-Traffic Queuing Principles (or Queuing Dynamics / Queuing Theory)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Checkpoint wait times and delays scale quadratically with passenger arrival variance ($C_a^2$) as checkpoint utilization approaches capacity ($\rho \to 1.0$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Prompts qualitative committee members to ask where the physical conservation laws or Navier-Stokes equations are; passengers are human travelers making cognitive choices.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Empirical Passenger Show-Up Curve Convolution (ACRP Report 40)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Convolving scheduled airline departure banks with empirical passenger arrival distributions peaking 90 to 120 minutes prior to takeoff ($t+1, t+2, t+3$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Calling passenger arrival timing physics-based prompts committee members to ask where physical conservation laws are.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Deterministic Operational Baseline
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Baseline model shifting published flight schedules forward across empirical ACRP Report 40 passenger arrival distributions without real-time delay telemetry or ML.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Using 'physical' implies mechanical engineering rather than an operational schedule baseline.

Draft_Jargon_or_Coined_Term: Deterministic Physical Rules / Physical Ebb and Flow
Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Deterministic Operational Rules / Operational Ebb and Flow
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: The recurring departure bank waves and scheduling rhythms established by published airline timetables.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Aviation planners evaluate operational bank structures; human flight schedules are not physical laws.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: True Empirical Lead-Lag Relationship (or Operational Lead-Lag Offset)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: The observed 90- to 120-minute operational time offset between when passengers clear security and when flights push back from gates.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: The time gap reflects traveler behavior and airline boarding cutoff rules, not physical mechanics.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Idiosyncratic Terminal Layouts and Gate Configurations
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Airport-specific spatial floorplans such as finger-pier concourses, terminal walkway connections, and satellite gate pods.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Over-mathematizes airport concourse architecture and spatial layouts.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Facility Operational Features (or Facility and Aircraft Features)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Screening lane counts, checkpoint finger-pier configurations, aircraft seating gauge, route load factors, and connecting passenger ratios.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Labeling operational checkpoint attributes as 'physical features' confuses architectural infrastructure with screening operations.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Carrier Isolation Structurally / Operationally Impossible
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Airports like Salt Lake City (SLC) where all airlines funnel passengers through a single consolidated central screening checkpoint.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: It is an architectural and operational routing constraint rather than a violation of physical laws.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Queuing Dynamics / Arrival Burstiness / Flight Bank Synchronization
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Rapid buildup of passenger crowds at security lines when airline banks cluster departures into tight 45-to-90-minute waves.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Borrowed physics jargon that obscures standard transportation queuing and airline scheduling phenomena.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Landside–Airside Volatility Interaction Term (or Joint Volatility Interaction)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Compounding operational stress when passenger arrival surges ($CV_{\text{TSA}}$) coincide with high flight departure delay dispersion ($\sigma_{\text{Delay}}$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Coined, proprietary acronym not found in FAA/IATA literature; multiplies mixed units (dimensionless ratio $\times$ delay minutes).

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Bivariate Volatility Stratification (or Cross-System Volatility Regimes)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Stratifying operational days or weeks by both passenger arrival variation ($CV_{\text{TSA}}$) and flight delay standard deviation ($\sigma_{\text{Delay}}$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Sounds like an invented mathematical artifact rather than standard bivariate empirical clustering.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Carrier Checkpoint Isolation (or Mathematical Separation of Demand)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Isolating single-airline terminal complexes to eliminate collinearity ($\kappa < 25$) among competing airlines scheduling simultaneous departure banks.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Borrowed electrical signal processing and Wiener-Hopf operator jargon that alienates aviation committee members.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Connecting Passenger Deflator (or Local Originating Passenger Fraction)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Multiplying departing seats by $(1 - \text{Connecting Ratio})$ using BTS DB1B ticket surveys to subtract transferring travelers who never enter landside security.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: A manifold is a topological differential geometry space; this is simple proportional subtraction of connecting travelers.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Zero-Bounded Count Regression (Tweedie Distribution)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: A generalized linear model distribution that naturally handles positive continuous counts and exact zeros without negative passenger predictions.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Overly dense statistical jargon that obscures the practical purpose of handling overnight checkpoint closures without artificial smoothing.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Consistent Passenger Arrival Timing
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Legacy carrier passengers exhibit similar lognormal arrival curves (mean $\sim 105$ min) whereas Southwest passengers follow bimodal timing due to open seating.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Bayesian exchangeability jargon that obscures airline-specific passenger boarding behavior.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Bimodal Intraday Operational Peaks: Morning Surges and Evening Delay Cascades
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Commercial airports experience a morning peak (05:00–08:00) driven by passenger surges and an evening peak (14:00–22:00) driven by compounding flight delays.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: 'Diurnal' sounds like biology; 'non-consecutive' overcomplicates a standard bimodal curve; 'turbulence' is borrowed fluid dynamics.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Intraday Operational Congestion Index (or Operational Stress Index)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Formula classifying hours of the day into Off-Peak, Mid-Peak, and Peak congestion blocks.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: "Turbulence Shock Index" sounds like aeroelastic flutter or fluid mechanics rather than queuing congestion.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Nominal On-Time Baseline (or FAA A14 Reference Standard)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Operating hours with flight departure delays under 15 minutes and zero cancellations reflecting undisturbed airline schedules.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: 'Quiescent' and 'sterile' are laboratory/medical terms; FAA and DOT use A14 on-time standards.

Draft_Jargon_or_Coined_Term: Checkpoint Demand is Quiescent / Curfew Quiescence
Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Checkpoint Demand is Minimal / Overnight Curfew Period
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Overnight hours (00:00 to 03:59) where flight departures cease and checkpoints experience scheduled closures or minimal traffic.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Laboratory physics jargon that obscures standard nighttime airport curfew closures.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Routine Daily Operations (or Ambient Operational Churn)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Everyday hub operations characterized by routine 15- to 30-minute departure delays and normal 1–2% flight cancellation rates.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Acoustic/signal processing jargon that mischaracterizes routine commercial flight operations.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Irregular Operations (IROPS) / Severe Convective Disruption
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Severe operational disruptions caused by summer convective thunderstorms or winter blizzards (delays $\ge 45$ min or cancels $\ge 5$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Hard-science physics jargon; commercial aviation universally uses the established industry term IROPS.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Peak-Hour Checkpoint Congestion
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: High-volume flight departure waves where passenger arrival rates approach screening lane capacity.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Theoretical mathematical jargon that obscures the practical reality of peak-hour line backups.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Post-COVID Study Period (or Training Window Start Date: May 1, 2022)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Selecting May 1, 2022 as the study start date following the judicial vacatur of federal transportation mask mandates.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Overcomplicated geopolitical jargon for explaining sample period selection and post-pandemic normalization.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Real-Time Prior-Hour Error Correction (or Live Prior-Hour Forecast Error Feedback)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Ingesting the prior-hour prediction error (actual throughput minus forecast) to dynamically update the current hour's checkpoint forecast.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: 'Innovation' sounds like corporate tech buzzwords; '1-step' is abstract algorithm speak for prior-hour error.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Requires No Real-Time Checkpoint Data Feeds (or Advance Scheduling Capability)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Model 2 (Supervised ML) relies solely on schedules and weather without needing real-time screening sensor feeds, enabling 24- to 72-hour advance staffing.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Misleading (Model 2 has no feedback loop at all; it is feed-forward); IT 'latency' obscures practical shift planning benefits.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Dual-Track Operational Decision Framework (or Disruption-Adaptive Checkpoint Forecasting Playbook)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: A decision playbook routing predictions to Model 2 during routine conditions and switching to Model 3 during severe convective disruptions.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: 'Gated' and 'inference engine' are AI runtime jargon; airport 'gates' also conflicts with aircraft parking positions.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Dynamic Two-Stage Hybrid Model (or Sequential Two-Stage Hybrid Model)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: A sequential model combining recurring flight schedules in Stage 1 with decision trees and live error feedback in Stage 2.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Robotics and control engineering jargon that obscures an intuitive two-stage operational forecasting structure.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Empty Checkpoint Fallacy (Stranded Passenger Underprediction)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: When open-loop machine learning assumes delayed flights mean empty checkpoints, ignoring passengers already stranded in the terminal lobby.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Essential operational concept explaining why pure ML fails during storms; describes traveler behavior rather than an algorithm flaw.

Draft_Jargon_or_Coined_Term: Type I (Air-Gapped) vs. Type II (Airside Connected) Complexes
Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Physically Separate Terminals vs. Walkway-Connected Terminals
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Terminals that are standalone buildings (e.g., LGA, DTW) versus terminals connected post-security by airside walkways (e.g., DFW, LAX).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Industrial engineering / network security jargon; transportation planning uses physical separation vs. walkway connections.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Post-Security Terminal Cross-Over
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Ticketed passengers clearing security in Terminal A and walking airside to board a flight departing Terminal B.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Epidemiological/fluid jargon ('leakage', 'cross-contamination') that inappropriately describes human traveler movement.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: The Hub Disconnect (or Connecting vs. Local Originating Disconnect)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: The mistaken planning assumption that every departing airline seat represents a passenger entering landside airport security.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Calling an empirical accounting omission a 'paradox' overcomplicates a straightforward hub transfer phenomenon.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Scheduled Checkpoint Closures vs. Missing Data
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Zero throughput recorded between midnight and 04:00 AM represents true physical lane closures rather than broken sensors.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Electronics hardware jargon; qualitative reviewers need to understand that nighttime zeros are real operational closures.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Unidentified Airport Records (Null Key Quarantining)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Quarantining 22,190 raw TSA records with missing or corrupted airport codes so they do not create a fake 9.71-million passenger airport.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Sensationalist lab jargon ('phantom mega-airport') that obscures standard data-cleaning surrogate key assignment.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Strict Information Causality
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Ensuring forecasting models only ingest operational attributes knowable before departure (prior-hour delays, scheduled seats).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Machine learning competition jargon; transportation economists and planners understand information causality and real-world availability.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Prospective Chronological Holdout Evaluation Matrix (or Temporal Holdout Benchmark Matrix)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Evaluating frozen models strictly forward in time on an unobserved future calendar year (2025) after training on historical operations (2022–2024).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Sounds like "running out of clock time" on an exam or an algorithmic compute timeout, rather than prospective chronological evaluation.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Routine Operational Accuracy (Robustness)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Model forecasting consistency and precision during nominal on-time flight operations under clear weather.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Control-systems engineering jargon that obscures day-in day-out baseline forecasting accuracy.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Resilience Under Severe Disruption
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: A model's ability to maintain accuracy, resist demand collapse, and recover quickly during severe storm ground stops.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Mechanical shock absorption jargon that obscures operational recovery during irregular flight operations.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Cross-Airport Transferability (Generalizability)
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Capability of a model calibrated at one airport to deploy directly to an unfamiliar airport without site-specific retraining.
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Abstract spatial topology jargon; airport authorities evaluate practical cross-airport portability.

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Disruption Error Multiplier
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Ratio of forecast error during severe flight disruptions to forecast error during routine operations ($\text{MASE}_{\text{shock}} / \text{MASE}_{\text{routine}}$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Over-mathematized metric name; plain English clarifies whether storm error doubles (fragile) or stays near 1.0 (resilient).

Recommended_Academic_Replacement: Transfer Error Penalty
Plain_English_Operational_Meaning: Ratio of zero-shot transfer forecast error to in-sample forecast error ($\text{RMSE}_{\text{transfer}} / \text{RMSE}_{\text{in-sample}}$).
Why_It_Risks_Committee_Scrutiny: Abstract acronym; plain English clarifies the percentage accuracy penalty incurred when deploying to a new airport.
